interpretation: Four original projects were new before this protocol. All 16 cases were predeclared; prompts, source, fixtures, graders, profiles, limits, and selection rules stayed fixed.
Correctness, allowed edit scope, project verification on final files, and completed turn are required independently. Failed and timed-out trials remain recorded.
The two repeats per project are eight pairs across four tasks, not eight independent fresh projects. Inspected cases are now known regressions for later tuning.
This is a local single-model sample, not a public benchmark or proof of general model reliability. The qualification verdict uses explicit heuristics, not a statistical significance test.
Builds and regression suites ran separately from live inference; no sampler settings or model defaults were changed.
Profile export is an explicit choice, not automatic default promotion. Native checks make zero generation requests; native signing is local/ad-hoc.
